description: Copy a form into a NEW draft, including any staged edits, its purpose, and its storage provider (the Drive folder is re-resolved, not copied). The copy collects nothing until it is published. Responses are never copied. Needs forms:write.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_duplicate_form
title: Duplicate a form
